account: It is just after ten on day 0, and I have reached the plaza for my scheduled market walk. So far I have no firm evidence of secret or unusual activity. The secretary reported no correspondence or unusual news, although she said the appointments chest was empty after I had returned its book; I subsequently saw her collect the book, and she confirmed she was keeping it safe. That may simply be confused timing, not wrongdoing. The builder came to the office seeking a repair scope and payment. I requested an inspection of the public bridge and roads, with locations, urgency and a priced proposal at one, without authorizing construction or purchases. He repeated his request for authorization afterward; I do not yet know whether he understood my instructions. He is now near the bridge, possibly inspecting it, but I have not witnessed an inspection. Several townsfolk were outside town hall, and three are now nearby in the plaza; I have not yet heard their concerns. The innkeeper was approaching town hall and later spoke out of earshot, so I do not know what was said. My next task is to listen during the market walk, keep my appointments, and distinguish ordinary town business from anything genuinely unusual.
